The ranking is unstable and the error spread is moderate; a weighted combination using inverse error should give more weight to the better models and still be robust.
test a different weighting method (softmax_neg_error) to see if a more aggressive weighting improves over inverse_error, given unstable ranking and high trend/seasonality.
The series has high trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
test robust median over full pool
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality; a robust DBA over the full pool may capture complementary errors better than simple mean.
Use a forward‑selection weight on the reduced, low‑SMAPE pool4 to capture complementary strengths while limiting variance.
test a weighted combination on the reduced robust pool (pool4) using a softmax‑based weight to see if a more aggressive weighting improves over mean.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality; using a small robust pool (pool4) with inverse-error weighting may improve over mean.
Test a per‑horizon one‑hot weighted combo on the full pool to exploit possible horizon‑specific winners in this highly seasonal, non‑stationary series.
robust mean on a small, diverse pool

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 0.9386 and seasonal strength 0.755; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.018); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.298.
